title: Scaling Automatic Research Agents via World Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.12564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automating empirical research is a long-standing direction of AI. Recent automatic research (AutoResearch) agents bring this goal within reach, as modern LLMs show the capability to independently implement solutions and learn from the execution outcomes. Behind these gains, post-training (especially RL) plays a central role. In this paper, we identify a fundamental tension when scaling RL for these agents: the two components of every AutoResearch trajectory (agent generation and environment execution) scale in very different manners, since all generation shares compute through batching, while each execution occupies its exclusive sandbox and real machine time. As a result, the environment execution dominates the training cost and becomes the bottleneck as trajectories grow. translated_title: 通过世界模型扩展自动研究代理
translated_abstract: 自动化实证研究是人工智能长期以来的一个方向。近期的自动研究（AutoResearch）代理使这一目标变得触手可及，因为现代大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出独立实现解决方案并从执行结果中学习的能力。在这些进展背后，后训练（尤其是强化学习，RL）起着核心作用。在本文中，我们识别出在为这些代理扩展RL时的一个基本矛盾：每个AutoResearch轨迹的两个组成部分（代理生成和环境执行）以非常不同的方式扩展，因为所有生成通过批处理共享计算，而每次执行占用其独占的沙箱和真实机器时间。因此，环境执行主导了训练成本，并随着轨迹的增长成为瓶颈。为了解决这一矛盾，我们提出了世界模型强化学习（WMRL），该方法用世界模型替代环境执行以消除这一瓶颈。此外，世界模型...
tldr: 本文提出世界模型强化学习（WMRL），通过用世界模型替代环境执行，解决了自动研究代理在强化学习扩展中环境执行成为成本瓶颈的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes World Model RL (WMRL), which replaces environment execution with a world model to resolve the bottleneck where environment execution dominates training costs during RL scaling for AutoResearch agents.
